title: How to Register for the Philippine National ID (PhilSys)

checklist.title: Check Eligibility
checklist.description: Ensure you are a Filipino citizen or resident alien at least 5 years old.

checklist.title: Prepare Documents
checklist.description: Gather primary identification documents such as a birth certificate or passport.

checklist.title: Register for PhilSys
checklist.description: Visit a registration center to provide your personal information and undergo document verification.

content.title: What is the Philippine National ID?

blocks.content: The **Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) National ID** is the official national identification system of the Philippines.
It provides every Filipino citizen and resident alien with a single, secure, and verifiable identity.
The National ID may be issued in different formats:
The system is managed by the **Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA)** under Republic Act No. 11055 or the PhilSys Act.

blocks.title: Is the Digital National ID valid?

blocks.content: Yes. The Digital National ID may be accepted for many transactions and identity verification purposes.

blocks.title: What if I lose my National ID?

blocks.content: You may request a replacement, subject to verification and applicable replacement procedures.

blocks.title: Can I use the National ID for banking?

blocks.content: Yes. Many banks and financial institutions accept the National ID as valid proof of identity.
